title: Filter
desc: Filter is a group of radio buttons. Choosing one of the options will hide the others and shows a reset button next to the chosen option.

items.desc: For a HTML <form> or a <div> element that includes radio buttons for filtering items
An alternative to the reset button if you can't use a HTML form

examples.title: Filter using HTML form, radio buttons and reset button
examples.description: A HTML form for filtering items
examples.liveHtml:
<form class="filter">
  <input class="btn btn-square" type="reset" value="×"/>
  <input class="btn" type="radio" name="frameworks" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Svelte"/>
  <input class="btn" type="radio" name="frameworks" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Vue"/>
  <input class="btn" type="radio" name="frameworks" autocomplete="off" aria-label="React"/>
</form>

html.code:

  <input class="$$btn $$btn-square" type="reset" value="×"/>
  <input class="$$btn" type="radio" name="frameworks" aria-label="Svelte"/>
  <input class="$$btn" type="radio" name="frameworks" aria-label="Vue"/>
  <input class="$$btn" type="radio" name="frameworks" aria-label="React"/>
</form>

examples.title: Filter without HTML form
examples.description: Use this if you can't use a HTML form for some reason

examples.title: Filter using HTML form, checkboxes, and a reset button
examples.description: For having multiple choices, use checkboxes.
